fact: Car 20 left the track at T4 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 20 attempted to overtake Car 22 at Turn 4 and in the process left the track. He did not give the position back and therefore gained a lasting advantage by leaving the track. We accordingly gave Car 20 a 10 second time penalty.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 20 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
to: The Team Manager, MoneyGram Haas F1 Team
